ProductType.name: Product Type
ProductType.definition: Contains the product type of the sale line item.

ProductCodeType.name: Product Code Type
ProductCodeType.definition: Contains a list of codes used to identify a product.

AdditionalProductCode.name: Additional Product Code
AdditionalProductCode.definition: Additional code related to the product.

AdditionalProductCodeType.name: Additional Product Code Type
AdditionalProductCodeType.definition: Additional type of codification  used to identify a product.

ProductCodeModifier.name: Product Code Modifier
ProductCodeModifier.definition: Code discriminator between a product code and its format to uniquely identify a specific product (for example, Item or pack of same items).

ProductDescription.name: Product Description
ProductDescription.definition: Description of the product or item.

UnitOfMeasure.name: Unit Of Measure
UnitOfMeasure.definition: Unit of measure of the item purchased.

NonAdjustedUnitPrice.name: Non Adjusted Unit Price
NonAdjustedUnitPrice.definition: Original, non-adjusted cost of one unit of the product or service before discounts and taxes.

NonAdjustedTotalAmount.name: Non Adjusted Total Amount
NonAdjustedTotalAmount.definition: Original, non-adjusted total cost of a product or service before discounts and taxes.

Adjustment.name: Adjustment
Adjustment.definition: Adjustment made to the original price.

AdjustedAmount.name: Adjusted Amount
AdjustedAmount.definition: Total cost of the line item amount, inclusive adjustments and exclusive of taxes.

InsuranceIndicator.name: Insurance Indicator
InsuranceIndicator.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Taxes applying to the good or item.

TotalAmount.name: Total Amount
TotalAmount.definition: Total cost of the line item, inclusive of all applicable adjustments and taxes.
